## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#84`

- **Status**: Active (Enforced)

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::RateProposalExpired` — the rate proposal's acceptance window has elapsed.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::rate_proposal_follows_the_two_step_window`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::rate_proposal_follows_the_two_step_window). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// RateProposalExpired — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
f.client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .propose_rate_change(&f.sender, &id, &1);
f.advance_time(RATE_PROPOSAL_TTL_SECONDS);
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_accept_rate_change(&f.recipient, &id)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked rate_proposal_follows_the_two_step_window
```

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Propose a fresh rate change; the acceptance window is bounded by the stream's `end_time`, and an expired proposal cannot be accepted.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#18-two-step-rate-renegotiation`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#18-two-step-rate-renegotiation)
